howto: A wall with a round door falls towards your ball.
Hold (finger, mouse button or Space) to grow; let go and you shrink.
When the wall reaches you, your ball must fit the door: never bigger, and not much smaller.
tips: You shrink as fast as you grow, so short taps make fine adjustments.
A ball just under the door size scores PERFECT.
Walls fall a little faster after every door you pass.
The text under your ball says whether you are growing or shrinking right now.

controls.keyboard: Hold Space to grow, release to shrink. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Press and hold anywhere to grow, lift your finger to shrink. Pause button top right.

difficulty: Easy allows a ball up to 14 px smaller than the door and slower walls; Normal 10 px; Hard only 7 px with faster walls.

cheats.effect: 8 px more room: slightly small balls still pass
A dashed ring around your ball shows the size of the next door

features.one-tap-start: Tap or Space on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the TOO BIG! / TOO SMALL! card
features.best-score-badge: BEST doors under the gate counter
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card with an animated hold gesture; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: TOO BIG! / TOO SMALL! card with doors passed and best, or ALL DOORS PASSED!
features.progression: Player level + XP bar, coins, stars, a date-seeded daily challenge (10-coin bonus), milestone achievements and 4 unlockable skins bought with coins (sky-PK-grow-shrink blob; HUD + title card visible without menus)
